name: AMT Initial Build & Re-expansion Procedure
description: Concrete procedural guidance for performing initial build and re-expansion of the Main AMT within a designated container, including sequencing, verification, and rollback rules.

principles.name: Sequential Build Order
principles.description: Initialization steps must execute in dependency order: container allocation → base configuration provisioning → module provisioning → integration verification.

principles.name: Container Isolation
principles.description: Each container must be treated as an independent execution boundary; no cross-container state leakage during build or re-expansion.

principles.name: Idempotent Re-expansion
principles.description: Re-expansion must produce a state identical to a fresh initial build; any deviation triggers a full rebuild rather than patching.

principles.name: Exact Container Targeting
principles.description: Always operate on the exact container ID provided; never substitute, generalize, or fuzzy-match the target container identifier.

principles.name: Main AMT Hierarchy Preservation
principles.description: Preserve the 'main amt' designation through both build and re-expansion so the primary AMT remains primary and sibling AMTs remain subordinate.

heuristics.action: Run diagnostic scan on prior state; if corruption detected, discard and perform fresh initial build
Rollback to last known good state; log failure; halt deployment

heuristics.condition: Container ID not found in registry
heuristics.action: Abort initial build; return error code REBUILD_REQUIRED with message 'Target container missing from registry; cannot proceed without prior registration'

heuristics.condition: The container's pre-operation state snapshot is missing
heuristics.action: Abort the operation and capture a fresh snapshot before retrying.

decision_rules.name: rule 0
decision_rules.condition: Target is restoring Main AMT to a known-good prior state OR version upgrade requires full reset
decision_rules.outcome: Execute RE_EXPANSION mode: load snapshot, validate integrity, apply delta if version compatible, verify against baseline

decision_rules.name: rule 1
decision_rules.condition: All initialization steps completed without error AND integration suite passed
decision_rules.outcome: Mark build as SUCCESS; enable Main AMT runtime; log completion timestamp

decision_rules.name: rule 2
decision_rules.condition: Re-expansion target version differs from current by more than one minor release
decision_rules.outcome: Abort re-expansion; require INITIAL_BUILD instead; log warning 'Version gap too large for safe re-expansion; fresh build required'

decision_rules.name: rule 3
decision_rules.condition: Target is first-time setup of the Main AMT in the target container OR prior build state is corrupt/missing
decision_rules.outcome: Execute INITIAL_BUILD mode: allocate container, provision base config, run full integration suite, mark SUCCESS only after all pass

decision_rules.name: rule 4
decision_rules.condition: Input specifies a container ID AND the work concerns an AMT
decision_rules.outcome: Resolve the target container by its exact ID — never substitute or fuzzy-match it; verify it exists in the registry and is classified under AMT; fail if it does not exist or is not AMT-tagged.

decision_rules.name: rule 5
decision_rules.condition: An initial build is followed by a re-expansion of the same container
decision_rules.outcome: Run the initial build first and do not start re-expansion until it reports success with zero errors; capture the build artifacts and use them as the re-expansion baseline; never run the two in parallel.

decision_rules.name: rule 6
decision_rules.condition: The work concerns the main AMT of a container
decision_rules.outcome: Confirm the main designation before any build step (set it first if it is unset), preserve it through build and re-expansion, and fail the workflow if it cannot be confirmed.

decision_rules.name: rule 7
decision_rules.condition: A re-expansion has completed AND no error flags are set on the container
decision_rules.outcome: Validate that the container is in a consistent post-expansion state with the main AMT intact and sibling AMTs unaffected; report success, or restore the pre-expansion snapshot.

decision_rules.name: rule 8
decision_rules.condition: An initial build or re-expansion is about to run on a container
decision_rules.outcome: Capture a snapshot of the container's current state first; if the operation fails, restore that snapshot.
